core.title: Ridged Curved Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull, Omnia 9449
tags: Contemporary curved Kitchen cabinet door pulls

text.description_html:
Omnia 9449 Brushed Stainless Steel Finish Curved Cabinet Handle

Ultra minamalistic in design, this stainless steel cabinet door pull made by Omnia is sure to add a chic touch to your home. The ridges on the pull give this cabinet handle a utilitarian look. The most prominent trait of this brushed stainless steel finished cabinet knob is the modern curve; and since it is available in 4 sizes, you will be sure to find just the right one.

Since this contemporary cabinet pull is so easy to clean it will maintain a smooth, rich luster for the lifetime of your home; and just like all Omnia's stainless steel cabinet handles, the modern styled pull will prove worthy of the exceptional standards that Omnia has sustained for more than 40 years.

Available in 4 Sizes:

  • OMN-9449/96 - Length: 3-3/4", Projection: 1-1/8"
  • OMN-9449/128 - Length: 5", Projection: 1-3/16"
  • OMN-9449/192 - Length: 7-5/8", Projection: 1-3/8"
  • OMN-9449/320 - Length: 12-7/16", Projection: 1-3/8"
